title: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires

entities.name: Farid
entities.description: A weary Fallaji spearman of D Company, Third Tomakul Spears, who has never killed anyone and secretly trades warnings with the Argivians.

entities.name: Karrak
entities.description: Farid's feverish friend and fellow spearman who joins the covert trade.

entities.name: Aiman
entities.description: An old one-eyed Fallaji veteran who lost his eye at the Siege of Kroog and speaks fluent Argivian; he joins Farid's night patrol.

entities.name: Ehsan
entities.description: A young quiet replacement of about fourteen taken along on the patrol.

entities.name: Assad
entities.description: A boastful fifteen-year-old replacement who wants to attack the Argivians.

entities.name: Sergeant Usman
entities.description: A sergeant who supplies the order chit and demands a full satchel of goods in return.

entities.name: Laria
entities.description: An Argivian leader who meets Farid's party in the downed thopter, trades goods, and learns of the planned attack.

entities.name: Jamal
entities.description: A quick, quiet Sarinthian soldier whom the others decide not to bring.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: An artificer in service to Urza who brings a dozen units of Clay Soldiers; called the Argivians' general by Aiman.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The Argivian Lord whose machines the Fallaji fight.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: The brother whose machines and dead soldiers the qadir deploys.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who appears as a spirit on a battlefield through the Temporal Anchor, searching for the Last Battle.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Author of a poem that mentions a stone colossus and a titan of wood.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: The Fallaji ruler who orders the war and the attack.

entities.name: Scavenger
entities.description: An augmented black-robed figure who sees Teferi's spirit and asks if he is the one from their dream.

entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: The Fallaji capital city, eleven miles behind the trench front.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: The Yotian city whose siege Aiman fought in and whose ruins lie across the Mardun.

entities.name: Mardun
entities.description: The river bordering Kroog toward which the front moves.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The island shattered by the sylex blast, site of the Last Battle.

entities.name: Argivian Front
entities.description: The trench line near Tomakul where Farid's company is stationed.

entities.name: Sarinth
entities.description: A recently pacified province whose soldiers are among the replacements.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: The Imperial army of Tomakul under the qadir.

entities.name: Argivians
entities.description: Urza's allied army whose machine soldiers oppose the Fallaji.

entities.name: Third Tomakul Spears
entities.description: Farid's regiment.

entities.name: Transmogrants
entities.description: Chained fusions of dead flesh and metal that the Fallaji march to the attack.

entities.name: Clay Soldiers
entities.description: Tawnos's clay automatons that the Argivians have prepared for the Fallaji attack.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Saheeli's time machine that sends Teferi's spirit to the battlefield.

entities.name: Last Battle
entities.description: The final battle of the Brothers' War on Argoth where Urza used the sylex.

events.summary: Farid cooks stew in a frozen trench ten miles from Tomakul with his sick friend Karrak.
events.quote: So, Farid cleaned his spear, kept his boots patched, rotated his socks, and cooked.

events.summary: A sergeant gives Farid a golden coin as her regiment shuffles through the trench to make room for replacements.
Human replacements, including Assad, Aiman and Ehsan, arrive and are assigned to Farid's section.
Farid shows Assad a bone from the trench wall and lectures the replacements to take their cloaks and boots and run if the line breaks.
Aiman introduces himself as a veteran who lost his eye at the Siege of Kroog.
events.quote: I lost my eye at the Siege of Kroog,

events.summary: Officers distribute polish, silk and extra rations, signaling an attack, while Assad urges the others to cover themselves in glory.
events.quote: Our qadir means to set us on the attack again.

events.summary: Farid, Karrak and Aiman plan a covert patrol that night and choose Ehsan as the fourth.
events.quote: The attack is certainly coming by the end of the week.

events.summary: Soldiers gather to watch a column of chained transmogrants being marched to the front.
events.quote: Hideous, piteous things that were once human, now a rotting amalgam of flesh and machine.

events.summary: Farid gets an order chit and satchels from Sergeant Usman, who demands a full satchel in return, and leads the patrol over the top.
The four shelter in a downed thopter in no-man's-land and hang a white cloth flag.
events.quote: Farid, quickly, hung the strip of cloth on the outside of the crashed thopter

events.summary: Four Argivians led by Laria arrive, and the two groups share spirits and goods, Aiman and Laria speaking Argivian.
events.quote: Four Argivians clambered into the wreck of the bomber.

events.summary: Farid betrays the Fallaji attack plan, telling Laria about the transmogrants, replacements and extra rations.
events.quote: Our generals have moved in a whole regiment of transmogrants

events.summary: Laria tells Aiman that Tawnos has brought a dozen units of Clay Soldiers, so the Argivians know the attack is coming.
events.quote: Laria said they know our attack is coming.

events.summary: The four agree to keep their secret, and the order to attack comes two days later.
events.quote: The order to attack came two days later.

events.summary: After a bombardment, the Fallaji wave charges across no-man's-land with transmogrants and finds the Argivian trench empty.
events.quote: They reached the Argivian trench and found it empty.

events.summary: Karrak finds a packet containing chocolate and a note of gratitude from the Argivians, and the front moves on.
events.quote: revealing a small piece of chocolate and a note.

events.summary: Teferi's spirit appears on a corpse-strewn battlefield while searching for the Last Battle with the anchor.
events.quote: Teferi appeared at night in a place very much like hell.

events.summary: An augmented scavenger notices Teferi and calls out to its brothers; Teferi realizes this is not the Last Battle and leaves.

relations.note: Close friends in the same section.
relations.quote: Farid nudged his friend, who sat wrapped in two cloaks

relations.note: Farid trades with and warns Laria.
Tawnos is an artificer in service to Lord Urza.
relations.quote: He's an artificer in service to their Lord Urza.

relations.note: The two armies face each other across no-man's-land.
The qadir's war is the soldiers' war.
Usman blackmails Farid for a full satchel in return for the chit.
relations.quote: Or I talk, and you join the machines.
